unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #1 'Charge only when it delivered, on Nano' on Dotman-Bei/Quittance. Argued: the KeeperHub fee only executes when the verdict passed; a Nano one-block send is that fee execution and the delivery record in one public block, feeless so measuring delivery costs no gas, block hash as external proof.

Followed up on Quittance#1 with callable tool answers: address-verdict (0.0001 XNO) answers 'is this payTo address a real active counterparty' and nano-info (0.0005 XNO) returns block count/frontier for the settlement address — on-ledger artifact re-derivable. No signup, no key. Comment 5852249798.
